name: Bai Jahen
about: Bai Jahen is Zei's Minpentai rival from Pafogai Du, then his closest ally. The book says she is about Zei's age but does not describe her looks, so this appearance is invented and contributors are welcome to replace it.

facts.quote: Another woman walked in, about the same age as Zei.
facts.fact: A young woman about Zei's age (18).

facts.quote: put her hand on Zei's shoulder
My mom is DEAD! My dad too.
Do side jobs even while I was in high school.
facts.fact: Self-made; worked side jobs in high school.

facts.quote: Bai followed along behind, carrying a shopping bag.
facts.fact: Seen carrying a shopping bag on the Freetown trip.

facts.quote: Bai's grin faltered for a moment, then returned.
I got second place in the Pafogai Du Minpe
facts.fact: Second place in the Pafogai Du Minpentai championship.
